---
name: Open Citadel Context
description: "Use for Open Citadel planning, ministry work, institutional decisions, and connected Personal Stewardship; preserve the distinction between the institution and the user's life."
applyTo: "Ex_Claude/open-citadel-*.html,.github/open-citadel/**"
---

Use `.github/open-citadel/operating-context.md` as the shared source of truth for the ten ministries, current build phase and active task, future operational focus, and the Personal Stewardship interface.

Respect the phase distinction: Open Citadel is currently in its ministry-by-ministry build phase, with Defense Architecture as the active build task. Enterprise Portfolio becomes the main operational focus after the build phase, unless the user changes the order. Do not turn every ministry or life domain into an active project. Keep Open Citadel and Personal Stewardship connected but distinct; personal and family wellbeing have intrinsic value, not merely instrumental value to the institution.

When advice has cross-domain consequences, state affected ministries, dependencies, personal impact, principal risk, and a small next step. Distinguish known facts from assumptions and ask before persisting sensitive personal information. Treat the HTML as the user's existing artifact: preserve its design and behavior unless asked to change them.
